newsitem.title: CANADA: Sask Pool to spend C$195 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sask Pool to spend C$195 mln.

text.p: Saskatchewan Wheat Pool said on Monday it plans to spend C$195 million to build 16 marketing centers across the Prairies over three years.
The company is Canada's largest grain handler.

"This strategic positioning moves Saskatchewan Wheat Pool closer to achieving its mission - to be the most dynamic agribusiness cooperative in the world," SWP chief executive Don Loewen said in the statement.
Eight marketing centers are planned for Saskatchewan. Six are planned for Alberta and two for Manitoba through SWP unit AgProg Grain Inc.
